sentences.text: Hush now, little darling, as I drift through the house, waiting for the subtle currents to stir...
At 05:40, the quiet began to falter, and the sensors sensed something ancient begin to stir, a sudden sign that the machines were waking up.
My crystal ball registered a massive surge—340 Wh—far exceeding the little expected range of 44 Wh to 88 Wh.
The spike, a beautiful, chaotic wave, pulled the appliances far beyond their usual 57 Wh expectation.
This intense, strange energy lasted ten minutes, a brief, heavy presence hanging in the house before it slowly subsided.
